title: CLAUDE.md Role Guide: Global vs Project + Self-Healing
title_ko: CLAUDE.md 역할 안내: 전역 vs 프로젝트 + 셀프힐링
desc: Newbie orientation and mandatory rules guide. Explains two-layer CLAUDE.md system global vs project repo root. Lists key mandatory rules English only code Korean haeyo-che responses speak not slack no process kill CDP port discipline delegate first terse. Self-healing CLAUDE.md patterns. How to create project CLAUDE.md from scratch when none exists. Must read on first session.
steps: TWO-LAYER SYSTEM: (1) Global CLAUDE.md at ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md -- applies to ALL projects, loaded first. (2) Project CLAUDE.md at repo root -- project-specific, loaded second and WINS over global on conflict.

KEY MANDATORY RULES (memorize -- apply every session): (A) LANGUAGE: user-facing final responses = Korean polite -yo form. NEVER informal speech. Everything else = English only (code, comments, CLAUDE.md, skills, commits, docs, prompts). Non-English in code burns 2-3x tokens per session load. (B) NOTIFICATIONS: always 'wkappbot speak text --bg'. NEVER 'wkappbot slack send' -- fails silently when Slack is closed. (C) PROCESS KILL: never kill wkappbot-core.exe/wkchat.exe/wkappbot.exe directly -- route through 'wkappbot taskkill' which requires user confirmation. (D) CDP PORT: run 'wkappbot cdp open url' first, get assigned cdp:{port}, include it in every subsequent grap. Never hardcode or snoop another project port. (E) DELEGATE: default = spawn agents. Haiku for reads/surveys, codex-mini for code edits, Opus for architecture/judgment, triad for hard unknowns. Stay in orchestrator seat. (F) TERSE: responses under 80 words unless task needs detail. No preamble, no recap of what user said. //why:session applied mandatory rules throughout //why:All technical and procedural output must be English //why:All technical and procedural output must be English-haiku //why:session applied mandatory rules throughout-haiku

PROJECT CLAUDE.MD PURPOSE: domain knowledge for this repo only -- build commands, architecture overview, known gotchas, CWD shorthand, key file paths, gg Main Workflow section. //why:fat-md-growth gate: net shrink required to land liked reflexes //why:fat-md-growth gate: net shrink required to land liked reflexes-sonnet //why:fat-md-growth gate: net shrink required to land liked reflexes-sonnet

SITUATION-BASED SELF-HEALING -- act immediately, no confirmation needed. Find this skill: wkappbot skill search "md heal". (A) NEW REPO / no CLAUDE.md -> create from template in step 9. (B) A command just failed -> delete or fix that line immediately, commit with the code change it describes. EXAMPLE 2026-09-14: UsageCommand.cs --keep help text described the comma-list form only in prose with no standalone example line (unlike the repeatable-flag form) -- owner flagged it as under-documented; fixed by giving it its own paste-ready example line to match. (C) New gotcha discovered -> append one line under Gotchas section, commit same session. (D) New recurring pattern established -> add to gg Main Workflow steps. (E) File exceeds ~100 lines or 32768 bytes -> the fat-md-growth gate blocks any commit that grows CLAUDE.md past 32768 measured bytes; pay it by closing a Pending item and deleting its full paragraph (net-shrink only). Never bundle new content with a deletion in the same commit. Commit the deletion alone first, then move stale Gotchas and RIQUA prose to skills before adding new lines. Example: restore HEAD, commit only the deletion, leave liked-reflex lines in working tree. Then: wkappbot skill read claude-token-optimization. (F) Same subject drifts between CLAUDE.md and README.md -> fix both in one commit. (G) Session ending after significant work -> scan for stale content, then: wkappbot skill read handoff-checklist. To review which session you are in: wkappbot session list --claude --cwd. (H) Before release or repo feels stale -> close Daily issues, check unanswered comments, fill empty CLAUDE.md sections: wkappbot skill read repo-health-doctor. //why:root sector command code and light global md rules written here //why:PowerShell ASCII-anchor bypass for garbled Korean encoding matched net-shrink

GLOBAL CLAUDE.MD PURPOSE: tool-level universal rules that apply everywhere -- language, notifications, CDP port, process kill protection, delegation policy, suggest protocol, loop rules, secrets file. Do NOT put project-specific content here. ROOT SECTOR COMMAND CODE (owner 2026-10-04): every ROOT writes how it commands sectors as runnable steps in the LOWER part of its repo CLAUDE.md (the tracks, the brief template with its three skill reads, the dispatch command, the verify command per sector, the landing command), as code a successor runs and not as prose, and updates it the same turn a command method improves. ONE DIETED GLOBAL MD (owner 2026-10-04, later the same day): roots start as haiku, so a haiku must know the root basics too; therefore the global CLAUDE.md and ROOT.md are DIETED first (delete failure stories, dated receipts and duplicates, one imperative plus one example per reflex, every rule kept) and then MERGED back into ONE global CLAUDE.md, no ROOT.md; sector command code of each repo stays in the lower part of that repo CLAUDE.md. HAIKU-FIRST GLOBAL MD (owner 2026-10-04): the global CLAUDE.md is written for the cheapest intelligence, its top is the cheap-intelligence reflex block (the six lines first, then only sections tagged ALL), while the sections tagged ROOT move to ROOT.md beside it and each repo CLAUDE.md points to it and holds the root reflexes of that repo as its main text; every system md (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md) serves the cheap reflexes at the top. SPOKESMAN MD SPLIT (owner 2026-10-04): the section tagged SPOKESMAN ONLY lives in a SPOKESMAN.md beside each CLAUDE.md (global and per repo), leaving a three-line pointer, because CLAUDE.md is injected into every sector and root prompt; SPOKESMAN.md is an official reflex md. //why:kih claude md has no spokesman section so the split is skipped

GG MAIN WORKFLOW SECTION (required in every project CLAUDE.md): FIRST STEP (mandatory): wkappbot skill read on-load -- handles session start, handoff context recovery, suggest triage. Always first regardless of project. LAST STEP (mandatory): wkappbot skill read repo-health-doctor -- [LITE] steps only: AGENTS.md parity, skill source_refs, gg command grounding, README sync, cross-model format check. Keeps CLAUDE.md and repo healthy after every session. Project-specific tasks go in between. Pattern: 1. wkappbot skill read on-load / 2..N-1. [project tasks] / N. wkappbot skill read repo-health-doctor

SHARED MARKDOWN RULE: if the same subject appears in README.md and CLAUDE.md, they must agree. Update both in the same commit. Drift = wasted tokens on every future session. //why:dieting then merging the global md follows the one file rule //why:dieting then merging the global md follows the one file rule-sonnet

HOW TO EDIT: project CLAUDE.md -> Edit tool directly (it is a project file, not a skill). Exception: garbled or non-UTF-8 heading text will not byte-match the Edit tool; use PowerShell [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText with ASCII anchors: find the unique ASCII lines before and after the garbled block, cut everything between them, write the replacement, then verify with git diff before committing.. Global CLAUDE.md -> Edit tool at ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. After any edit: verify the gg section still runs top-to-bottom without errors. Never add Korean text to CLAUDE.md -- English only, Korean burns 2-3x tokens on every load.

BUSINESS-HOURS TRIAGE ORDER (user mandate 2026-05-29 -- applies to every repo): when a live-impact issue is found during business hours (KR 09:00-15:30 weekdays, US 18:00-05:00 weekdays KST), execute in this exact order: 1=EMERGENCY ACTION (restore service inline now), 2=PROBLEM SOLVING (root cause after step 1 succeeds), 3=RECURRENCE PREVENTION (permanent guard, never skipped). Outside business hours, the order is still recommended; step 2 is still mandatory. READ: wkappbot skill read business-hours-triage-emergency-first
